members with<strong> 117 </strong>loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. </p><p><strong>Friday 7 August from 12pm until 1:30pm:</strong> Tickets will be sold to members person.  </p><p><strong>Tickets will be sold online only. </strong></p><h2>Application process for supporters with access needs </h2><p>Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit <a fullTicketInfoLink.content: <p>Ticket sales for this match will be as follows:</p><p><strong>Luton have taken an increased allocation in the Shed End for this fixture meaning we have to displace all season ticket holders in the Shed upper and Shed lower tiers. Therefore, displaced season ticket holders can purchase any of the available seats not taken by a season ticket holder during the reservation period. There will be a specific on-sale period providing displaced season ticket holders with the priority opportunity to purchase elsewhere in the stadium.</strong></p><p><strong>From Tuesday 18 August 10am until Thursday 20 August 9am: </strong>Season tickets holders can purchase their own seat (Including those enrolled on the cup scheme). You will find your reservation under the ‘reserved tickets’ once you have logged into your account via the ticketing portal.</p><p><strong>Thursday 20 August 10am until 2pm: </strong>Displaced supporters in the Shed lower and Shed upper tiers have priority to buy another available seat in other areas of the stadium.</p><p><strong>Thursday 20 August 3pm until Friday 21 August 9am: </strong>Season ticket holders who have not purchased a seat will be able to purchase any remaining seat that has not been taken by a fellow season ticket holder in the reservation period. </p><p>Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets are allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application.</p><p><strong>Ticket application window opens – Tuesday 18 August 12pm</strong></p><p><strong>Ticket application window closes – Thursday 20 August 12pm  </strong></p><p>Season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, and Junior Blue members can now purchase an additional two tickets (maximum of three tickets in total per person). </p><p>The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members.</p><p>As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider.</p><p>Tickets for this match are priced at <strong>Category G</strong>. <a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/ticket-prices-men" title="">Please click here for match ticket prices</a></p><p>Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event.</p><p>Eligible members can submit their application at any time during the window. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them.</p><p>As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate.</p><p>You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application.</p><p>Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases.</p><ul><li><p><a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/faqs-ticket-application-window" title="">Ticket application window FAQs</a></p></li></ul><p>Tickets are for Chelsea supporters only. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over.</p><h2>Additional Information<strong> </strong></h2><p><strong>From Friday 21 August </strong>Season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, and Junior Blue members can now purchase an additional two tickets (maximum of three tickets in total per person)</p><h2>Club Chelsea Westview</h2><p>Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Carabao Cup home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date.</p><p>All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to <a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/club-chelsea-ticket-terms-and-conditions" title="">Club Chelsea terms and conditions. </a>For any further Westview enquiries, please email <a target="_blank" href="mailto:clubchelsea@chelseafc.com" title="">clubchelsea@chelseafc.com</a>.</p><h2>Loyalty points</h2><p>Loyalty points will now only be awarded for <em><u>attendance</u></em> at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile.</p><p>This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Please note those with Ticket Forwarding Memberships will not accrue loyalty points for attendance. </p><p>Supporters will receive five loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played.</p><h2>Application process for supporters with access needs</h2><p>Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below:</p><p><strong>Accessible ticket application window opens – Tuesday 18 August 12pm</strong></p><p><strong>Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 20 August 12pm</strong></p><p>Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on <a target="_blank" href="tel:0371%20811%202012" title="">0371 811 2012</a> or <a target="_blank" href="tel:0044%20207%20915%201950" title="">0044 207 915 1950</a> (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window.</p><p>Supporters who are looking to gain access to a lift when attending a fixture, please email <a target="_blank" href="mailto:access@chelseafc.com" title="">access@chelseafc.com</a></p><h3>Accessible car parking</h3><p><a target="_blank" href="https://cfcsupportersclubs.powerappsportals.com/Request-Accessible-Parking/" title="">Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here</a> from <strong>Friday 21 August</strong></p><p>You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge.</p><h2>Ticket exchange</h2><p>Those who have enrolled on the home cup scheme can now list on the ticket Exchange. </p><p>This will close 3 hours before kick-off.</p><p>Please note that supporters on the home cup scheme  who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange.</p><p>Only season ticket holders and members will be able to purchase home games through the ticket exchange. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the Official Ticketing Platform.</p><h2>Ticket forwarding</h2><p>Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until <strong>three hours before kick-off. </strong>Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange.</p><ul><li><p><a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/digitaltickets" title="">Click for ticket forwarding FAQs</a></p></li></ul><h2>Refunds</h2><p>Refunds will only be made in accordance with the Conditions of Issue. Requests to refund tickets purchased from the general admission on-sale period must be submitted via the form below.</p><p><a target="_blank" href="https://cfcticketing.powerappsportals.com/forms/Refund-Request/" title="">Click for refund request form</a></p><p><strong>Match and ticket application window dates are subject to change. All ticket sales are subject to availability. Please check the website for the latest information.       </strong></p>

fullTicketInfoLink.content: <h2>Travel disruption warning</h2><p><strong>Supporters intending to travel to or from this game using the London Underground are advised that planned engineering works may affect your journey. There will be no District Line service between Tower Hill and Edgware Road to Wimbledon, Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Ealing Broadway stations. This means Fulham Broadway Station will be closed all day and there will be no District Line trains running to any nearby stations on that branch of the tube network. There is also no Circle Line from Edgware Road to Aldgate (via Victoria). </strong></p><h2>Ticket sales information</h2><p>Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application.</p><p><strong>Ticket application window opens – Friday 21 August 12pm</strong></p><p><strong>Ticket application window closes – Wednesday 26 August 12pm</strong></p><p>The Ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, and Junior Blue members.</p><p>As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider.</p><p>Tickets for this match are priced at <strong>Category B</strong>. <a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/ticket-prices-men" title="">Please click here for match ticket prices</a></p><p>Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. </p><p>Eligible members can submit their application through the <a target="_blank" href="https://www.eticketing.co.uk/chelseafc" title="">ticketing portal</a> at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate.</p><p>You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application.</p><p>Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases.</p><h2>Useful Links</h2><p><a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/faqs-ticket-application-window" title="">Ticket Application Window FAQs</a></p><p><a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/ticket-office-opening-times" title="">Click for ticket office opening times</a></p><p><a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/ticket-office-faqs" title="">Click for Frequently Asked Questions</a></p><p><strong>Tickets will be sold via the ticket application window and are for Chelsea supporters only. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over.</strong></p><h2>Club Chelsea Westview </h2><p>Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date.</p><p>All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to <a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/club-chelsea-ticket-terms-and-conditions" title="">Club Chelsea terms and conditions. </a>For any further Westview enquiries, please email <a target="_blank" href="mailto:clubchelsea@chelseafc.com" title="">clubchelsea@chelseafc.com</a>.</p><h2>Loyalty points </h2><p>Loyalty points will now only be awarded for <u><em>attendance</em></u> at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile.</p><p>This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches.</p><p>Supporters will receive three loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. </p><h2>Application process for supporters with access needs </h2><p>Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the Accessible Ticket Application window. Timings are below:</p><p><strong>Accessible ticket application window opens - Friday 21 August 12pm</strong></p><p><strong>Accessible ticket application window closes – Wednesday 26 August 12pm</strong></p><p>Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on <a target="_blank" href="tel:0371%20811%202012" title="">0371 811 2012</a> or <a target="_blank" href="tel:0044%20207%20915%201950" title="">0044 207 915 1950</a> (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. </p><h2>Accessible car parking </h2><p><a target="_blank" href="https://cfcsupportersclubs.powerappsportals.com/Request-Accessible-Parking/" title="">Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here</a> from <strong>Friday 28 August</strong></p><p>You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. </p><h2>Ticket exchange</h2><p>In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the Official Ticketing Portal. The sales information on the Buy Tickets page will be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close <strong>three hours before kick-off, </strong>unless stated otherwise.</p><p>Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window will have a ticket exchange priority window.</p><h2>Ticket forwarding</h2><p>Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until <strong>three hours before kick-off. </strong>Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. </p><p><a target="_blank" href="https://www.chelseafc.com/en/digitaltickets" title="">Click for ticket forwarding FAQs </a></p><h2>Refunds </h2><p>Requests to refund tickets purchased from the general admission on-sale period, must reach the ticket office no later than <strong>3pm on Thursday 3 September (seven working days before the fixture).</strong> Refunds will only be made in accordance with the Conditions of Issue. <u><strong>Tickets purchased via the ticket exchange are non-refundable, these sales are final. </strong></u></p><p><a target="_blank" href="https://cfcticketing.powerappsportals.com/forms/Refund-Request/" title="">Click for refund request form</a></p><p><strong>Match and ticket application window dates are subject to change.
